)fr(2W!Bfpj=.s|Q}h41: Click the white rook to toggle between the two AI modes and player mode for white.
Click the black rook to toggle between the two AI modes and player mode for black.
AI Lozza mode refers to a chess bot that behaves more like a human and is less strong.
AI Stockfish mode refers to a chess bot that behaves less like a human and is stronger.
Player mode means another person (local) is playing. Local means the player will be using the same device as you. Plans to add online multiplayer in the future are being considered.

The AI level sliders determine how strong the AI will be. Level 0, for example, is a very weak AI that makes completely random moves. Level 50 is an AI that makes decent moves and has a 50 percent chance of doing something random. Level 100 is an AI that always makes strong moves and has a 0 percent chance of doing something random. It is most likely impossible to beat, at least for a human.
